description: Read relationship signals across a conversation, infer what changed between turns, then turn awkward, overly formal, blunt, or AI-sounding messages to teachers, leaders, mentors, senior colleagues, partners, acquaintances, or potential professional contacts into short, natural, relationship-aware communication. Use for tactful praise, upward communication, progress updates, favors, reminders, apologies, disagreement, gift and courtesy messages, proxy greetings, holiday wishes, warm friend-like chat, trust-building, private invitations, role entrustment, third-party endorsement, and deciding when not to convert goodwill into a request.
